data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello. Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects properly. As a workaround, you can also log in using your standard email and password if SSO is not enforced. [T-3804] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
